name: aerial_sheep_yolox_s
validation_notes: Public Domain: no attribution obligation follows this model. Genuine nadir aerial imagery, splits verified free of augmentation leakage. Trained on sheep, which are the conservative case for cattle. NOT validated on Canadian field imagery. Decision support only.
trained_on: Aerial Sheep Dataset by Riis, via Roboflow Universe (Public Domain) -- mirrored as keremberke/aerial-sheep-object-detection

name: imageweeds_yolox_s
validation_notes: Genuine nadir aerial imagery, verified by inspection. Only transplanted potted specimens are annotated -- natural weeds in every frame are unlabelled and train as background, so recall is capped by the annotation and measured precision understates reality. The species head collapsed: 76% of test predictions are horseweed (14% of ground truth). Localisation is sound -- scored as a single class, AP@.50 is 0.520 against 0.246 for species. Run it with inference.collapse_labels_to: weed. One site, one season. NOT validated on Canadian field imagery. Decision support only.
trained_on: Project-AgML/ImageWeeds_aerial_weed_detection (CC BY 4.0) -- credit Rai, N., Villamil Mahecha, M., Christensen, A., Quanbeck, J., Zhang, Y., Howatt, K., Ostlie, M., Sun, X. 'Multi-format open-source weed image dataset for real-time weed identification in precision agriculture.' Data in Brief 51 (2023), 109691

name: weed_crop_yolox_s
validation_notes: NOT aerial despite the name: ground-level close-ups plus indoor propagation trays, and 98.3% of `crop` labels come from the trays. Effectively a seedling detector at ~30-80 cm range. Class balance 95% weed / 5% crop. NOT validated on Canadian field imagery. Decision support only.
trained_on: LibreYOLO/weed-crop-aerial (CC BY 4.0) -- credit Roboflow 100 / Roboflow Universe

name: yolox_s_coco
validation_notes: Stock COCO detector, exported unchanged as a pipeline smoke-test model. It detects none of this project's targets -- no weed, crop or prairie species class exists in COCO. Its `sheep` and `cow` classes are ground-level-trained and are NOT the livestock model. Never deploy this for agronomy. Decision support only.
trained_on: COCO 2017 (Microsoft) -- images CC BY 4.0 / Flickr terms, annotations CC BY 4.0. Stock YOLOX-s weights from Megvii (Apache-2.0); no agricultural data involved.
